This rich multiple is completely unsupported by the underlying financial reality, as the company suffers from destructive profitability marked by an ROCE and ROE of -16.1% and a median return on equity of -16% [E5, E6, E9, E34]. Operational performance compounds these concerns, evidenced by a staggering compounded profit growth rate of -1550% over the trailing twelve months and a low interest coverage ratio [E7, E28]. Cash generation is equally distressing, with operating and free cash flows landing in negative territory at Rs -0.37 Cr and Rs -0.40 Cr respectively for March 2026 [E14, E15]. Furthermore, speculative enthusiasm has drastically outpaced delivery as price growth exceeds profit growth by a massive 1548%, leaving the stock perched dangerously near the top of its 52-week range at 90% despite returning -2% over the past year [E4, E8, E24]. Conceded: promoters hold 68.60% as of June 2026 after increasing their stake by 12.43 percentage points since September 2023 [E20], and the capital goods sector enjoys a tailwind score of +0.68 [E37].
